# D&T Group

> D&T Group is an international EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) contractor specializing in large-scale infrastructure and commercial projects across Turkey, the CIS region, and beyond.

D&T Group operates as a multi-disciplined engineering and contracting company with subsidiaries including Dogu Electrical and Electronics Contracting Co. and Tron Engineering and Contracting Co. The company has extensive experience in airports, healthcare facilities, educational institutions, industrial plants, commercial real estate, and residential developments across diverse geographic markets.
